# Scott Lewis

## About
Scott Lewis is a senior full stack developer focused on building modern web applications, cloud-native solutions, and developer tooling with React, .NET, and JavaScript-based product engineering. He has experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and delivering customer-facing software across multiple industries.

## Professional focus
- Full stack web development
- React and TypeScript application architecture
- .NET, cloud integration, and backend services
- Product engineering, mentoring, and team leadership
- Architecture, system design, and developer experience
